prompt: What would be misleading about reporting all Elm tables as East territory demand?
promptZh: 若把所有 Elm 邊桌都列為東區需求，會造成什麼誤導？

options.text: It would show the East center as receiving fewer tables than it will actually handle.
options.zh: 顯示東區中心收到的邊桌比實際經手的少。
options.whyZh: 東區中心確實會收到全部貨品，問題不在收貨數量。

options.text: It would treat a warehouse transfer as another order for Elm tables.
options.zh: 把倉庫轉運誤算成另一張 Elm 邊桌訂單。
options.whyZh: 全部歸東區是區域歸類錯誤，不是把同一批貨當成兩張訂單。

options.text: It would identify Rowan’s receiving point but conceal where some of the tables will first be sold.
options.zh: 只反映 Rowan 的收貨地點，卻掩蓋一部分邊桌首次販售的地點。
options.whyZh: 貨都經東區中心，但有一半會在開賣前轉往西區並在那裡首次販售。

options.text: It would imply that Rowan is already selling the tables in West stores.
options.zh: 暗示 Rowan 已在西區門市開賣這些邊桌。
options.whyZh: 全部列東區反而不會反映西區的銷售地點，也不表示已經開賣。

explanationZh: 貨都經東區中心，但有一半會在開賣前轉往西區並在那裡首次販售。

vocabulary.note: 此處按商品第一次銷售的地點歸類，不按貨物最先入庫的點。

evidence: use the place where the items will first be offered for sale to assign the sales territory. / A transfer through a warehouse does not change the territory. / The Elm side tables will all go to Rowan’s East distribution center. / Staff there will send half on to West stores before the range goes on sale; the other half will be sold in East stores.
